reserves.name: USDT deposited into Steakhouse-curated Morpho lending markets
reserves.issuerOrObligor: Tether USDT and Steakhouse-curated Morpho Blue markets

reserveReview.rationale: The Steakhouse Prime USDT vault is a Morpho ERC-4626 vault whose underlying asset is USDT. Morpho documents that shares are minted only by depositing the vault's underlying token and that vault capital can be allocated among same-asset Morpho markets. The full reserve is therefore the direct linked USDT wrapper position, without estimating changing borrower-market allocations.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Current Morpho vault asset and documented V1 allocation model
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The complete direct reserve relationship is USDT. Market allocations, borrower collateral, and withdrawal liquidity vary on-chain, but do not change the vault's underlying reserve token.

providers.name: Steakhouse Prime USDT MetaMorpho vault and Morpho Blue market contracts

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Assets are held by noncustodial vault and market contracts and are intentionally supplied into lending markets. The changing allocation set, legal bankruptcy treatment, and provider shares are not established by the reviewed static disclosures.
